claim: *The structural move: entities and typed relations.* Nodes are the entities a question needs; edges are the declared relations between them, and the edge label carries the meaning. Its analyses are graph operations — reachability, path, and cycle checks.

topology.description: Directed dependency graph; dashed crossed bypass is forbidden, not observed traffic.

required_terms: Entities and declared structural relations Analyze reachability, paths/cuts and cycles.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: WEB depends on API; API reaches DATABASE and CACHE. A crossed dashed bypass from WEB to DATABASE is forbidden. The accompanying labels identify dependency semantics, structural questions and typical graph analyses. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
